counterexample: Let σ=(1 2 3 4 5 6 7) and τ=(1 3 2 4 5 6 7). Both are 7-cycles, but σ⁻¹τ=(1 2 3), and σ together with this 3-cycle generates A7, not any of the three groups listed.
assessment_summary: Step 0025 gives a false classification. Two 7-cycles are even, so they cannot generate S7; they can instead generate A7, which the proof omits. Thus the step is not justified as written.
